2. Dormant  $H=0$  factories have an exact passive limit

The accepted  $H=0$  auxiliary sites provide an especially clean calculation because their noise is an exact sector of the same fixed bath.

For an auxiliary qubit,

 $\mathcal L_{\mathrm{aux}}(\rho)
=
\sum_{P=X,Y,Z}\gamma_P(P\rho P-\rho),
\qquad
\gamma_P\ge\gamma_{\min}>0.$ Its Bloch multipliers are

 $\lambda_X(t)=e^{-2(\gamma_Y+\gamma_Z)t},$ with cyclic expressions for  $\lambda_Y,\lambda_Z$ . Consequently,

 $\lambda_X(t)+\lambda_Y(t)+\lambda_Z(t)
\le 3e^{-4\gamma_{\min}t}.$ Let  $\mathcal M_P$  measure Pauli  $P$  and prepare its measured eigenstate, and let  $\mathcal D$  be complete depolarization. Whenever  $\sum_P\lambda_P\le1$ ,

 $e^{t\mathcal L_{\mathrm{aux}}}
=
\sum_P\lambda_P\mathcal M_P
+
\left(1-\sum_P\lambda_P\right)\mathcal D.$ This is a convex combination of measure-and-prepare channels. Therefore the auxiliary channel is entanglement breaking by

 $\boxed{t_{\mathrm{EB}}=\frac{\log 3}{4\gamma_{\min}}.}$ For a specified anisotropic rate triple, the exact crossing is
 $\lambda_X+\lambda_Y+\lambda_Z=1$ . Necessity follows from the Choi-state Bell overlap

 $\frac{1+\lambda_X+\lambda_Y+\lambda_Z}{4},$ which exceeds  $1/2$  above that boundary and hence cannot belong to a separable two-qubit state.

Why increasing the auxiliary FT block does not fix this

A tensor product of these channels is entanglement breaking on any number of  $H=0$  carrier qubits. Encoding before HOLD and decoding afterward cannot restore entanglement with an untouched reference when all quantum carriers of the unknown state were in that sector.

For logical dimension  $d\ge2$ , feeding half of a maximally entangled state gives the lower bound

 $\left\|\mathcal D_{\mathrm{out}}
\circ\Phi_{\mathrm{aux},t}
\circ\mathcal E_{\mathrm{in}}
-\mathrm{id}_d\right\|_\diamond
\ge 2\left(1-\frac1d\right)$ for  $t\ge t_{\mathrm{EB}}$ , using diamond distance without a factor  $1/2$ .

This establishes a real architectural requirement: a coherent  $H=0$  factory checkpoint cannot simply be resumed after an arbitrarily long inactive HOLD. Its classical program may survive on the allowed reliable controller, and known resources may be prepared again, but the quantum preparation must actually be restarted or stored elsewhere.
